purpose: Reference-supported path-selection baseline for the Assembly Graph Twin de Bruijn graph

frozen_run_defaults.strand_representation: store each observed directed transition and its reverse-complement twin; deduplicate mirrored bubble candidates

labeling.method: bounded seed-and-extend edit-distance path alignment against reference and reverse complement
labeling.truth_scope: reference-supported path compatibility, not variant truth
labeling.ambiguous_candidates: retain as unlabeled when multiple branches align
labeling.unlabeled_candidates: retain when no branch aligns or alignment search is truncated

reference_validation.read_placement: sampled exact-seed anchors on both strands with unique-locus filtering; estimated whole-read spans, not gapped alignment
reference_validation.seed_length: min(15, shortest_reference_length); independent of graph k
reference_validation.reference_index_stride: 1 when seed length is below 8; otherwise 12
reference_validation.query_seed_stride: 2 when seed length is below 8; otherwise 8
reference_validation.minimum_anchors: one for reads shorter than two seeds, otherwise two separated anchors
reference_validation.reference_breadth: union of estimated placed-read spans, reported as an estimate
reference_validation.edge_support: fraction of oriented graph edges traversed by at least one uniquely anchor-placed read

graph_model.type: bidirected de Bruijn graph represented as a directed double-cover
graph_model.read_support: a physical read supports each orientation-specific transition once; reverse-complement twin transitions are added as the same molecule's opposite-strand view
graph_model.reported_counts: oriented node and edge counts are paired with reverse-complement-collapsed counts; component, tip, branch, and complete-candidate summaries collapse mirror views where identifiable; search-limit events are orientation-specific
limitations: This is not a compact canonical-k-mer or node-side-port implementation.
Oriented graph size may exceed the forward-only representation.
Read support is per oriented node/edge and must not be summed across reverse-complement twins as independent molecules.
